Hi Alex/Priya — thanks for the clear asks, happy to provide the technical details. Answers below inline to keep traceability: 

> Does Redwood support SSO/SAML?
Yes — Redwood supports SAML 2.0 with both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows. We can provide our SP metadata file (attached: saml-metadata.xml) and an example IdP configuration snippet. We also publish recommended SAML bindings for common IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, Ping).

> SCIM provisioning (push/deprovisioning)?
Yes — we support SCIM 2.0 for user provisioning and deprovisioning. Provisioning is token-based (bearer token) over TLS. We support create/update/patch/delete operations and include group membership sync for role mapping. Attached: scim-config-snippet.txt with endpoint examples and recommended rate limits.

> RBAC / admin controls (separation of duties, export controls)?
Redwood has role-based access controls with the following role scopes: account_admin, org_admin, team_admin, developer, and read_only. Only account_admins and org_admins can manage SSO/SCIM tokens and export user lists. We will include screenshots of the admin console showing role assignment and audit log entries (attached: rbac-screenshots.zip).

> SOC 2 evidence
We can share a SOC 2 Type II summary and selected control artifacts (policy excerpts, change management evidence, and sample audit logs). The full SOC 2 report requires an NDA and a short attestation; we typically provide the summary plus a scoped evidence pack over a secure transfer. I've attached redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. For tighter controls, we can route the full report through your procurement security portal.

Next steps from engineering:
- I'll assemble a technical evidence pack (SAML metadata, SCIM config, RBAC screenshots, sample logs) and upload it to our secure evidence link: https://secure.redwood.ai/evidence/ACME-4231 (will send a one-time access token).
- Offer: 30-min technical walkthrough — we can demo SSO flow and SCIM provisioning with a test tenant. Available slots: Thu 03/05 09:00-11:00 PT or 13:00-15:00 PT. Let us know which works.

Attachments included: saml-metadata.xml; scim-config-snippet.txt; rbac-screenshots.zip; redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

Regards,
